measures.name: User Defined Census Count
measures.dax:
SWITCH(
    SELECTEDVALUE('Filter Adults Peds'[Filter Adults Peds], "(All)"),
    "(All)", SUM(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Count]),
    "Adults", SUM(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Count Adults]),
    "Peds", SUM(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Count Peds])
)
measures.description: Census count switched by the Filter Adults/Peds parameter.

measures.name: Default Start Date
measures.dax:
VAR _m = MONTH(TODAY())
VAR _y = YEAR(TODAY())
RETURN
IF(
    _m >= 7 || _m <= 9,
    DATE(_y, 1, 1),
    IF(_m < 7, DATE(_y - 1, 7, 1), DATE(_y, 7, 1))
)
measures.description: Default start date for the reporting window.

measures.name: Start Date
measures.description: Selected reporting window start (defaults to Default Start Date).

measures.name: End Date
measures.description: Selected reporting window end (defaults to Default End Date).

measures.name: Date Range Filter
measures.dax:
VAR _d = MAX(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Date])
RETURN
IF(_d >= [Start Date] && _d <= [End Date], TRUE(), FALSE())
measures.description: TRUE when the row's Census Date is within the selected window.

measures.name: Start Month Contains Partial Data?
measures.dax:
VAR _maxCensus = MAX(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Date])
VAR _start = [Start Date]
VAR _firstOfMonth = DATE(YEAR(_start), MONTH(_start), 1)
RETURN
IF(
    YEAR(_maxCensus) = YEAR(_start)
        && MONTH(_maxCensus) = MONTH(_start)
        && _start <> _firstOfMonth,
    1,
    0
)
measures.description: 1 when the start month of the window is only partially covered.

measures.name: End Month Contains Partial Data?
measures.dax:
VAR _maxCensus = MAX(Midnight_Census_Template[Census Date])
VAR _end = [End Date]
VAR _lastOfMonth = EOMONTH(_end, 0)
RETURN
IF(
    YEAR(_maxCensus) = YEAR(_end)
        && MONTH(_maxCensus) = MONTH(_end)
        && _end <> _lastOfMonth,
    1,
    0
)
measures.description: 1 when the end month of the window is only partially covered.

measures.name: Partial Months in View?
measures.dax:
VAR _s = [Start Date]
VAR _e = [End Date]
RETURN
IF(
    DAY(_s) <> 1 || DAY(_e + 1) <> 1,
    "**Partial months are displayed in GRAY**",
    ""
)
measures.description: Warning text shown when the window includes partial months.
